evidence.scope: Full original camera route sampled at every CINE key with two completed frames each. This is not a wall-clock playback or device FPS claim.

quality.frameTiming: CPU submission; harness frame intervals measure throughput
quality.lighting: PBR with fixed dusk source direct and indirect diffuse
quality.waterModel: warped five-scale current + capillary rain rings / angularly perturbed linear planar reflection
quality.lightingModel: Original Cycles direct + indirect diffuse on all static source meshes; live direct/IBL specular and clearcoat
quality.lightmapUnits: source diffuse radiance with runtime irradiance multiplier
quality.staticDiffuse: Source direct + indirect only; live diffuse disabled, specular preserved
quality.shopFillModel: Three source-pose wide shadow Spots replace unshadowed LTC interior fills; upstairs reach bounded to rooms

displayPipeline.output: linear Rec.709 then renderer output transfer once
